digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and structured output handling
propositions: Consolidate all mode='structured' consumers to route exclusively through the single-operation PydanticAIRunner facade, removing bespoke output-attempt scheduler and retry machinery.

Unify output-retry budget management: seed both the in-Agent retries={"output":N} and the constructed UsageLimits request_limit addend from one output_retry_allowance() value, ensuring the request budget never exhausts before the output-retry counter.
Preserve structured_retry_limit=0 single-shot fail-safe behavior (zero output-repair retries and zero usage addend) to maintain overlap/judge.py and contracts.py batch abstain contracts.
Verify that well-formed first responses trigger exactly one agent.run_sync call; only the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade legitimately produces two; never a third.
Maintain existing provider fallback order, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized output shapes without breaking public re-export paths or patch/import seams.
Confirm via mode-resolving AST census that every in-tree structured consumer is reachable only through get_runner(...).run(...) facade and that structured dispatch is single-sourced.
